pageProps.review: Introduces how to use uiautomator, an Android UI testing framework, to automate interactions between apps at the system level and dump the UI hierarchy of the current screen into XML for analysis.
pageProps.description: Inspect UI hierarchy using uiautomator dump
pageProps.content:
## uiautomator dump
```uiautomator``` is a UI testing framework provided by Android.  
The important thing is that system-level manipulation is possible.  


You can manipulate not only the app you created but also other apps appearing on the screen.  
Therefore, it is essential for testing interactions or automation.  


You can see the <mark>hierarchy of all UI elements</mark> visible on the current screen in XML format.
```sh
{
    "title": "uiautomator dump"
}
---
$ adb shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/window_dump.xml
$ adb pull /sdcard/window_dump.xml
```
An example of the dump XML is shown below.
```xml
{
    "title": "UI Hierarchy example"
}
---
<hierarchy rotation="0">
  <node index="0" text="" resource-id="" class="android.widget.FrameLayout" package="com.android.systemui" ...>
    <node index="0" text="12:00" resource-id="com.android.systemui:id/clock" class="android.widget.TextView" bounds="[50,20][200,80]" ... />
    <node index="1" text="OK" resource-id="android:id/button1" class="android.widget.Button" bounds="[100,1000][300,1100]" clickable="true" ... />
  </node>
</hierarchy>
```
